Use only ids from the reference data given (vendor ids, PO ids, property ids, expense account ids). Amounts are integer cents. If a field isn't in the message, return null. Code the GL from the work described, not from who sent it: repairs and service calls are repairs, installations of new equipment and renovations are capital improvements.
